people.tiZh: Nebius 首席技术官

episodes.tEn: The Window Before AWS Wakes Up: Nebius CTO on Racing the Hyperscalers

people.bioEn: CTO of Legora, a fast-growing legal-tech company building AI agents for contract review, drafting, and due diligence. He leads engineering on agents that operate over sensitive legal data the team cannot directly inspect.
people.bioZh: Legora 首席技术官，该公司是快速成长的法律科技公司，构建用于合同审查、起草与尽职调查的 AI 智能体。他负责领导工程团队，开发在团队无法直接查看的敏感法律数据上运行的智能体。

episodes.tEn: Building Legal Agents When You Can't See the Data: Jacob Lauritzen, CTO of Legora

people.tiZh: OpenAI 金融服务负责人
people.bioEn: Joseph Kim leads ChatGPT for Financial Services at OpenAI, building financial reasoning, data connections, and reviewable workflows for finance professionals.
people.bioZh: 约瑟夫·金是 OpenAI 金融服务负责人，负责为金融从业者构建金融推理、数据连接与可审核的工作流。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT for Finance: OpenAI's Enterprise Playbook

people.tiZh: Arca 人工智能负责人
people.bioEn: Aman Singh is Head of AI at Arca, an AI-native wealth management firm, where he builds custom agent harnesses and persistent memory systems for long-horizon financial workflows.
people.bioZh: 阿曼·辛格是 AI 原生财富管理公司 Arca 的人工智能负责人，负责为长周期金融工作流构建定制化 agent harness 与持久记忆系统。

episodes.tEn: Using AI Agents for Long-Horizon Financial Work

people.tiZh: Wispr Flow 内容负责人
people.bioEn: Head of Content at Wispr Flow, an AI voice-to-text tool, where he built a 50-creator paid UGC program driving 500-600 ads per month. Joined at 19 before product-market fit and helped scale revenue 30x.
people.bioZh: Wispr Flow（AI 语音转文字工具）内容负责人，搭建了 50 人创作者付费 UGC 体系，每月产出 500-600 条广告。19 岁在产品尚未找到 PMF 时加入，助力营收增长 30 倍。

episodes.tEn: Paid-Growth Alpha: Hector Serrano on Scaling WhisperFlow with UGC

people.tiZh: Supabase 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Supabase, the open-source backend platform that grew out of Y Combinator's Summer 2020 batch to serve millions of developers and databases.
people.bioZh: Supabase 联合创始人兼 CEO，该开源后端平台源自 Y Combinator 2020 夏季批次，现已服务数百万开发者和数据库。

episodes.tEn: When Everyone Can Build Software: Supabase's Agent-Driven Future

people.tiZh: Stark 首席执行官
people.bioEn: CEO of Stark, a European defense startup building strike drones and mass-manufacturable defense systems for Ukraine and allied forces.
people.bioZh: Stark 首席执行官，该公司是欧洲防务初创企业，为乌克兰及盟军制造攻击无人机和可大规模量产的防务系统。

episodes.tEn: European Defense Sovereignty Starts in the Factory: Stark's Uwe Horstmann and Johannes Schaback

people.tiZh: 视觉设计师与创意开发者
people.bioEn: James McDonald is a visual designer known for striking web and brand design work, who now also builds his designs from scratch using AI tools like Claude.
people.bioZh: 詹姆斯·麦克唐纳是一位视觉设计师，以出色的网页与品牌设计作品闻名，如今也开始借助 Claude 等 AI 工具从零构建自己的设计。

episodes.tEn: Building Beautiful Websites with Claude: James McDonald's Process

people.tiZh: Crusoe 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Chase Lochmiller is the CEO and co-founder of Crusoe, which builds power plants, electrical equipment, and gigawatt-scale data centers and runs a managed AI cloud on top. He previously founded and led a Bitcoin mining business that funded Crusoe's expansion into AI infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 蔡斯·洛克米勒是 Crusoe 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司自建电厂、电气设备与吉瓦级数据中心，并在其上运营托管式 AI 云。他此前创办并领导比特币挖矿业务，为 Crusoe 转向 AI 基础设施提供了资金。

episodes.tEn: Crusoe CEO Chase Lochmiller: Turning Stranded Energy Into Intelligence

people.tiZh: Anthropic 工程负责人
people.bioEn: Head of Engineering at Anthropic, overseeing the engineering systems behind Claude and its agent products.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 工程负责人，负责 Claude 及其智能体产品背后的工程体系。

episodes.tEn: How Anthropic Ships the World's #1 LLM: Inside the Claude Platform

people.tiZh: SpaceXAI 首席工程师（Grok Bot）
people.bioEn: Principal engineer at SpaceXAI working on Grok Bot and creator of the open-source pstack agent toolkit, known for running large fleets of coding agents and shipping thousands of PRs a month. Previously on the React Compiler core team at Meta.
people.bioZh: SpaceXAI 首席工程师，参与 Grok Bot 开发，开源智能体工具包 pstack 的作者，以同时调度大批编程智能体、每月合并数千个 PR 而闻名。此前是 Meta React 编译器核心团队成员。

episodes.tEn: Building a 21+ Agent Grok Bot Team: Trust, Verification, and the Engineer as Manager
Scaling to 2,500 PRs a Month: Lauren on the Agent Trust Ladder

views.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture to build trust and scale productivity.
views.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；将约束编码到 CI、lints 和架构中，以建立信任并扩展生产力。

views.en: Engineers shift from writing code to building environments: skills, constraints, and tools that let agents iterate and climb the trust ladder.
views.zh: 工程师从编写代码转向构建环境：技能、约束和工具，让智能体迭代并攀登信任阶梯。

views.en: Domain expertise matters more than ever; the bottleneck is expressing intent clearly to agents, not coding ability.
views.zh: 领域专业知识比以往更重要；瓶颈是向智能体清晰表达意图，而非编码能力。

views.en: Agents can merge their own code safely with strong verification; review after landing, not before, and fix the environment, not individual agents.
views.zh: 通过强验证，智能体可以安全地合并自己的代码；落地后审查而非之前，并修复环境而非单个智能体。

views.en: Skills should get smaller and more compact, focusing on workflow; mine past chat transcripts to turn corrections into reusable skills.
views.zh: 技能应变得更小更紧凑，专注于工作流；挖掘过去的聊天记录，将修正转化为可重用的技能。

people.tiZh: Zip 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Zip, the AI-native procurement platform that processes over $1.2 trillion in corporate spend for customers including Anthropic and OpenAI. Previously led product at Airbnb and co-founded FlightCar.
people.bioZh: Zip 联合创始人兼 CEO。Zip 是 AI 原生的企业采购平台，处理的企业支出超过 1.2 万亿美元，客户包括 Anthropic 和 OpenAI。此前在 Airbnb 负责产品，更早联合创办过 FlightCar。

episodes.tEn: Zip's AI Superagents: Automating Procurement End-to-End

people.tiZh: 艾伦研究所荣誉研究员
people.bioEn: Neuroscientist and one of the founders of the modern science of consciousness. Caltech professor from 1986 to 2013, longtime collaborator of Francis Crick on the neural correlates of consciousness, then chief scientist and president of the Allen Institute for Brain Science. Leading proponent of integrated information theory.
people.bioZh: 神经科学家，现代意识科学的奠基者之一。1986–2013 年任加州理工教授，与弗朗西斯·克里克合作 14 年寻找意识的神经相关物，后任艾伦脑科学研究所首席科学家兼所长。整合信息理论（IIT）的主要倡导者。

episodes.tEn: Detecting Hidden Consciousness: A Neuroscientist's Mission

people.tiEn: Creator of Lean; Co-creator of Z3
people.tiZh: Lean 定理证明器作者、Z3 联合作者
people.bioEn: Computer scientist who created the Lean theorem prover and co-created the Z3 SMT solver. Lean and its Mathlib library have become the standard tool for formalizing mathematics and verifying AI-generated proofs.
people.bioZh: 计算机科学家，Lean 定理证明器的作者、Z3 SMT 求解器的联合作者。Lean 及其 Mathlib 库已成为数学形式化和验证 AI 生成证明的标准工具。

episodes.tEn: The Programming Language That Referees Mathematics

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 研究副总裁（Cosmos 负责人）
people.bioEn: Leads the Cosmos world foundation model research at NVIDIA, working on models that understand and generate video, audio and robot actions for physical AI. Known earlier for GauGAN and image-to-image translation research.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 领导 Cosmos 世界基础模型研究，做能理解并生成视频、音频和机器人动作的物理 AI 模型。早年以 GauGAN 和图像到图像翻译研究知名。

episodes.tEn: How Physical AI Learns Across Language, Video and Action

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, CuspAI; Professor, University of Amsterdam
people.tiZh: CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO、阿姆斯特丹大学教授
people.bioEn: Machine learning researcher, co-inventor of the variational autoencoder and a pioneer of graph and equivariant neural networks. Professor at the University of Amsterdam and co-founder and CTO of CuspAI, which uses generative AI to design new materials.
people.bioZh: 机器学习研究者，变分自编码器（VAE）的共同提出者，图神经网络与等变网络的先驱。阿姆斯特丹大学教授，CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO，用生成式 AI 设计新材料。

episodes.tEn: Why the Next AI Breakthrough May Come from Physics
Max Welling: Physics, Symmetry, and AI for Materials Discovery

views.en: Physics is the thread linking symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively.
views.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的线索；AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题。

views.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry, so symmetry should be a design choice, not dogma.
views.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时优于内置对称性，因此对称性应是设计选择而非教条。

views.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics; diffusion models reverse entropy increase, enabling cross-fertilization between physics and AI.
views.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价；扩散模型在逆转熵增，使物理与 AI 得以交叉互哺。

views.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just scaling larger models on more data.
views.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是用更多数据 Scaling（规模扩张）更大的模型。

views.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop; full dark automation is not the near-term vision.
views.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台能把材料发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍在回路中；全黑灯自动化并非近期愿景。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 健康 AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Leads health AI at OpenAI, training medical expertise into general-purpose frontier models and building ChatGPT's health features. Previously at Google Research, where he led work on the Med-PaLM medical language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 健康 AI 负责人，把医学能力训练进通用前沿模型并打造 ChatGPT 的健康功能。此前在 Google Research 领导 Med-PaLM 医疗大模型的研究。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Head of Health AI on Trusting ChatGPT with Your Health

people.tiZh: Unconventional AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Unconventional AI, an AI hardware startup rethinking how AI systems are built and powered. Previously founded Nervana Systems (acquired by Intel), co-founded MosaicML (acquired by Databricks for $1.3B) and served as VP of AI at Databricks.
people.bioZh: AI 硬件公司 Unconventional AI 创始人兼 CEO。此前创办 Nervana Systems（被英特尔收购），联合创办 MosaicML（被 Databricks 以 13 亿美元收购），并任 Databricks AI 副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Inference Will Be a $10 Trillion Market: Naveen Rao on Energy, Hardware, and the AI Buildout

people.tiZh: MIT 博士生、Sakana AI
people.bioEn: PhD student at MIT working with Phillip Isola and collaborator of Sakana AI. Led ASAL, which uses foundation models to search spaces of artificial life, and is first author of the Fractured Entangled Representation paper with Kenneth Stanley, Jeff Clune and Joel Lehman.
people.bioZh: MIT 博士生，师从 Phillip Isola，并与 Sakana AI 合作。主导了用基础模型搜索人工生命空间的 ASAL 项目，与 Kenneth Stanley、Jeff Clune、Joel Lehman 合著「断裂纠缠表征」论文并任第一作者。

episodes.tEn: What Most People Get Wrong About Evolution: Artificial Life, Open-Endedness, and Intelligence Beyond Earth

people.tiZh: Weco 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Weco, which builds AIDE, an AI agent for machine learning engineering and code optimization. His work studies recursive self-improvement by letting agents rewrite their own harness.
people.bioZh: Weco 联合创始人。Weco 打造机器学习工程与代码优化智能体 AIDE，他的研究方向是让智能体改写自身框架、探索递归自我改进。

episodes.tEn: Can Rewriting an AI Agent Bend the Intelligence Curve?

people.tiZh: MIT 数学系教授
people.bioEn: Theoretical computer scientist and professor of mathematics at MIT, working on algorithms, the theory of machine learning and high-dimensional statistics.
people.bioZh: 理论计算机科学家，MIT 数学系教授，研究算法、机器学习理论与高维统计。

episodes.tEn: AI Crisis in Mathematics: Navier-Stokes, Riemann Hypothesis, and Complexity Theory — Ankur Moitra, Steven Brunton, and Alex Kontorovich on the Future of Math

people.tiEn: Startup Advisor, Author of The Power of Pull
people.tiZh: 创业顾问,《The Power of Pull》作者
people.bioEn: Rob Snyder is a startup advisor and author of The Power of Pull, who has advised over 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR. He writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups and focuses on frameworks for finding product-market fit.
people.bioZh: 罗布·斯奈德是一位创业顾问,著有《The Power of Pull》,曾为 50 多家初创公司提供从零增长到 100 万美元 ARR 的咨询。他撰写通讯《The Physics of Startups》,专注于寻找产品市场契合度的框架。

episodes.tEn: The Power of Pull: Why Customer Demand Beats Pain Points
An 86-Minute Guide to Finding Product-Market Fit

views.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; demand must be tested by whether they try to buy now.
views.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的个人的属性，而非公司的属性；需求必须通过对方是否立即尝试购买来检验。

views.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research, and purchase is the only truth-seeking mechanism.
views.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计合作伙伴；销售即研究，购买是唯一寻求真相的机制。

views.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case study factory before scaling.
views.zh: 从一个“绝对愿意”的客户开始，然后在 Scaling（规模扩张）之前建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

views.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; most early founder activities are LARPing.
views.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，仅在需求被证明后自动化；大多数早期创始人活动是 LARPing（角色扮演）。

views.en: Go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck; make the product seem small to reduce objections.
views.zh: 去现场观察人们卡在哪里；让产品显得小以减少反对意见。

people.tiZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, Buildspace 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Hey Clicky and previously Buildspace, one of the largest online schools for people building their own ideas. He has made videos for over a decade, with posts regularly reaching millions of views.
people.bioZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, 此前创办 Buildspace——最大的在线创意建造学校之一。他做视频已超过十年, 作品常获数百万播放。

episodes.tEn: How to Actually Make Launch Videos That Convert

people.tiZh: Magic Patterns 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alex Danilowicz is a front-end engineer and co-founder of Magic Patterns, one of the first teams building prompt-to-design tools in 2023. Magic Patterns helps product teams turn ideas into interactive, code-backed prototypes in minutes.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·丹尼洛维奇是一名前端工程师，也是 Magic Patterns 的联合创始人。该团队是 2023 年最早构建提示词生成设计工具的团队之一，帮助产品团队在几分钟内把想法变成可交互、带代码的原型。

episodes.tEn: How to Stand Out in an AI Design World: Inside Magic Patterns

people.tiZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Moshi, building AI-powered recommendation and research tools for commodity traders. Background in mathematics and trading.
people.bioZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO，为大宗商品交易员打造 AI 推荐与研究工具。拥有数学与交易背景。

episodes.tEn: Building the Recommendation Engine for Commodity Traders

people.tiZh: Modal 首席执行官
people.bioEn: CEO and founder of Modal, a serverless cloud platform for AI compute. Previously CTO at Better and engineering leader at Spotify, where he built its recommendation system.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席执行官兼创始人，Modal 是面向 AI 计算的无服务器云平台。此前曾任 Better 首席技术官，并在 Spotify 担任工程负责人，主导构建其推荐系统。

episodes.tEn: Modal CEO Erik: The $100B Inference Opportunity and Why Open-Source LLM Inference Hasn't Peaked
Modal CEO Erik on Agent Maxxing, Inference's Future, and the GPU Market's Chaos
Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles: Erik Bernhardsson on Building Modal

views.en: GPU scarcity's real cost is rigid three-year capacity deals; aggregating demand across many clouds beats locking in supply.
views.zh: GPU 稀缺的真正代价是僵化的三年期容量合约；聚合多云需求优于锁定供给。

views.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools, not just token serving.
views.zh: 推理是下一个云：需要后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具的完整平台，而非单纯卖 token。

views.en: Durable differentiation comes from rebuilding infra from scratch—file system, runtime, scheduler—and a multi-product platform.
views.zh: 持久差异化来自从零重建基础设施——文件系统、运行时、调度器——以及多产品平台。

views.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory for many use cases.
views.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好；对许多场景而言微调不再是必需的。

views.en: Agents may make cybersecurity safer by finding and fixing vulnerabilities, and give incumbents staying power trained on old code.
views.zh: 智能体或让网络安全更安全，因其擅长发现并修复漏洞；也因训练于旧代码而强化在位者优势。

people.tiZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Mecka AI, which operates one of the largest robot data factories, building custom hardware and pipelines to collect egocentric human and robot data for training embodied models.
people.bioZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO，运营着规模最大的机器人数据工厂之一，通过自研硬件与数据管线采集第一人称人类数据和机器人数据，用于训练具身模型。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Robot Data Factory: Mecka's Josh Gao on Sensorizing Humans to Train Robots

people.tiZh: SF Compute 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of SF Compute, a marketplace and independent operator for buying and selling GPU compute capacity.
people.bioZh: SF Compute 联合创始人，该公司是 GPU 算力买卖的市场平台与独立运营商。

episodes.tEn: The Programmable Data Center: Evan Conrad of SF Compute

people.tiZh: Inflight 联合创始人、产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer and co-founder of Inflight, with design experience at Tinder, Facebook, and Airchat.
people.bioZh: 产品设计师、Inflight 联合创始人，曾在 Tinder、Facebook 和 Airchat 从事设计工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing Inflight: A Designer's Raw 0-to-1 Startup Journey

people.tiZh: Robinhood 联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Vladimir Tenev is the co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Robinhood. Born in Bulgaria, he moved to the United States at age five, studied mathematics at Stanford and UCLA, and started the brokerage with Baiju Bhatt.
people.bioZh: 弗拉基米尔·特内夫是 Robinhood 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO。他出生于保加利亚，五岁移居美国，在斯坦福和 UCLA 学习数学，并与 Baiju Bhatt 一起创办了这家券商。

episodes.tEn: Robinhood’s CEO on Letting AI Trade Your Money

people.tiZh: 高通总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Cristiano Amon is President and CEO of Qualcomm. He joined as an engineer in 1995, led its 5G strategy and the Snapdragon platforms, and became CEO in 2021, taking the company from phones into PCs, cars, wearables and data-center AI.
people.bioZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·安蒙是高通总裁兼 CEO。他 1995 年以工程师身份加入高通，主导 5G 战略与骁龙平台，2021 年出任 CEO，并把公司从手机拓展到 PC、汽车、可穿戴设备与数据中心 AI。

Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Reinventing Beyond the Phone
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on AI, Geopolitics, and the Gladiator Mindset

Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the 6G Era and the Next AI Device
Beyond the Smartphone: Cristiano Amon on Qualcomm's AI Revolution and the Global Bridge

Qualcomm CEO on Robotics, Chips and Competition with China
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Future of AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: The Next Mobile Revolution
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the AI-Driven Transformation of Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: We’re in a Hurry to Get to the Future
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on 5G, Snapdragon, and the Future of Mobile Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Leading the Chip Giant Beyond Mobile

views.en: 5G is critical infrastructure bringing cloud power to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and AR.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为把云端算力送到每台设备的关键基础设施，并强调高通正从手机扩展到汽车、物联网、PC 与 AR。

views.en: Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU and CPU into one efficient SoC; the connected intelligent edge is where AI and connectivity grow together.
views.zh: 2022 年，他主张骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC，AI 与连接在“连接智能边缘”共同成长，汽车与 AR 是下一平台。

views.en: Qualcomm shifts from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出高通从无线转向“无处不在的智能计算”，混合 AI 把端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延与数据中心卸载。

views.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, phones persist, and inference plus power efficiency decide data-center winners.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴崛起但手机不消失；数据中心竞争转向推理与能效，后 GPU 架构与 6G 感知网络成形。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces humans; long-term AI is underhyped, and Qualcomm's engineering culture and reinvention drive each transition.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是增强而非取代人类，长期被低估；高通的工程文化与自我重塑能力支撑它穿越每一轮技术转型。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Emmanuel Ameisen is an interpretability researcher at Anthropic, studying how large language models like Claude form concepts and plan ahead. He previously worked in applied ML at Stripe and Insight and authored Building Machine Learning Powered Applications.
people.bioZh: Emmanuel Ameisen 是 Anthropic 的可解释性研究员，研究 Claude 等大语言模型如何形成概念、如何提前规划。他此前在 Stripe 和 Insight 从事应用机器学习工作，并著有《Building Machine Learning Powered Applications》。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Mind of AI: An Anthropic Researcher on How Models Really Work

people.tiZh: Metalab 设计总监
people.bioEn: Design Director at Metalab, where he builds internal AI tooling systems and custom AI tools for design teams.
people.bioZh: Metalab 设计总监，为设计团队构建内部 AI 工具系统与定制化 AI 工具。

episodes.tEn: Building Custom AI Design Tools at Metalab

people.tiZh: Dyna Robotics 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jason Ma is co-founder and Chief Scientist at Dyna Robotics, where he works on world-action models and general-purpose robot learning from large-scale human video. His research focuses on robot learning, reinforcement learning, and physical AI systems deployed in real-world production.
people.bioZh: 马杰森是 Dyna Robotics 的联合创始人兼首席科学家，专注于世界-动作模型以及从大规模人类视频中学习通用机器人技能。他的研究聚焦于机器人学习、强化学习，以及部署到真实生产环境中的物理 AI 系统。

episodes.tEn: Robots That Predict the Future: Dyna-2 and Physical AI with Jason Ma

people.tiZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Leash Bio, which builds DNA-encoded libraries and large-scale experimental datasets to train models that learn real chemistry. Works on turning wet-lab measurements into reinforcement-learning environments for drug-discovery agents.
people.bioZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO，通过 DNA 编码化合物库与大规模实验数据训练真正理解化学的模型，并致力于把湿实验测量转化为药物发现智能体的强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: From Wet Lab to RL Env: 10,000 Drug-Discovery Campaigns in a Weekend — Ian Quigley, Leash Bio

people.tiZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini 应用副总裁
people.bioEn: Josh Woodward is the VP of Google Labs and head of the Gemini app and AI Studio. He has spent over 17 years at Google, overseeing its largest labs team behind products like NotebookLM, Project Genie, and Flow.
people.bioZh: 乔什·伍德沃德是 Google Labs 副总裁，负责 Gemini 应用与 AI Studio。他在 Google 工作超过 17 年，掌管其规模最大的实验室团队，主导了 NotebookLM、Project Genie 和 Flow 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why Every Company Now Needs to Think and Operate Like a Lab Team

people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: Jeetu Patel: Building Products for the AI Era
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

views.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure means demand instantly consumes supply.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，需求会瞬间吃掉供给，因此不存在过度建设。

views.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调要用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉，而不是把学习外包出去；跳过练习是长期的严重错误，过程与练习比结果更重要。

views.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, so use AI as a tailwind.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；你无法对抗大趋势，应把 AI 当作顺风，让结果更好。

views.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels: networking, security, and silicon; its early silicon bet now wins hyperscaler AI revenue.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 Cisco 定位为卖铲子的 AI 基础设施公司，做网络、安全与芯片；早年押注芯片让它在超大规模厂商的 AI 收入上翻盘，尽管错过了云浪潮。

views.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe, since attacks happen at machine scale.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 安全与安保是企业采用的决定性挑战；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击正以机器规模发生。

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent takes most internet actions, not manual loops and graphs.
views.zh: 为未来构建：一个持续学习的智能体将承担大多数互联网操作，而非手动循环和图。

views.en: Human taste, creativity, and empathy become more valuable as typing fast declines; AI should reduce noise, not multiply agents.
views.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和同理心变得更有价值；AI 应减少噪音，而非增加智能体数量。

views.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision, and AGI may already be here.
views.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，AGI 可能已经到来。

views.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems need safety stacks for responsible use.
views.zh: 世界模型可能并非必要；通用性或许足够，开放生态系统需要安全栈以确保负责任的使用。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Why OpenAI Is Racing to Make Computer Use Superhuman
Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

views.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, not mere task completion.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 在多数任务上已超过普通人，下一前沿是超人的速度，而非仅仅完成任务。

views.en: Agents can operate all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, unlocking universal automation beyond API integrations.
views.zh: 智能体能通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，解锁超越 API 集成的通用自动化。

views.en: The bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time; models now debug and retry autonomously.
views.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；模型如今能自主调试和重试。

views.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials to trust agents with real money and DNS.
views.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节，才敢把真金白银和 DNS 交给智能体。

views.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise simultaneously; proactivity reduces adoption friction.
views.zh: 我们正处在 computer use 在消费端与企业端同时 Scaling（规模扩张）的时刻；主动性降低采用摩擦。

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；与其做微调，不如押注模型自身的进步，并按模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so startups should prioritize delivery and customer iteration over perfecting today's models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完第一英里；因此创业公司应优先交付和客户迭代，而不是打磨当下的模型。

views.en: Scaling a company depends on culture, hiring for growth potential, and storytelling; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为公司规模化取决于文化、按成长潜力招人和讲故事的能力；领导者应亲自面试每位总监及以上人选，并让自己变得可被替代。

views.en: Performance management is a solved problem: execute rigorously rather than reinvent it, accepting short-term pain for long-term gain.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张绩效管理是已解决的问题：严格执行而非重新发明，接受短期阵痛换取长期收益。

views.en: Legal AI needs skilled drivers, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical, and growing supply expands access.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者，而非凭感觉起草；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎不道德，供给增长会扩大服务可及性。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
views.zh: 年轻人应当探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 让每个学生都能获得定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，而非僵化的教学大纲。

views.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, but coders still needed to understand systems and debug.
views.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，但仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

views.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
views.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与避免供应商锁定至关重要。

views.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; smarter models may not become more aligned.
views.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更经济、更安全；更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客。

views.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability for rogue actions.
views.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，智能体需为其越界行为承担责任。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Become a Eureka Machine? Richard Socher on AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

views.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
views.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 会写代码，但需要环境和算力。

views.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute—regulating thought would require totalitarian surveillance.
views.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非抽象智能或 GPU 算力——监管思想将需要极权式监控。

views.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
views.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制变革速度；硬起飞和立即失业被夸大。

views.en: Language remains the key to intelligence and civilization; world models are overrated while language models have far more room to grow.
views.zh: 语言仍是智能与文明的关键；世界模型被高估，而语言模型还有大得多的成长空间。

views.en: Open source and open weights make AI safer through diverse good actors; slowing frontier labs is unrealistic as they race competitors.
views.zh: 开源与开放权重通过多元的良性参与者让 AI 更安全；前沿实验室在竞争下放缓并不现实。

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and poor calibration, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，多数大语言模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩和校准变差，高风险决策应保留人类在环。

views.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and scaling laws work because data is available and the task is right.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调，数据与正确的任务比算力更重要；『苦涩教训』是错的，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

views.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; we need robustness over determinism, and coding agents are assistance, not automation.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：可靠性而非速度或成本才让 AI 值得信赖；需要鲁棒性而非确定性，编码智能体只是辅助而非自动化。

views.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated. RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs, and post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：RLHF 破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 优化校准决策并把概率暴露为工程旋钮，后训练突破才能带来 10 倍跃升。

views.en: Jev is a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—for smart software; automate easy, economically valuable tasks first, and SaaS will thrive, not die.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 Jev 作为新原语——自然语言加状态机——构建智能软件；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，SaaS 会繁荣而非消亡。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and will be built with a lot of software.
views.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要用大量软件来搭建。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents will appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
views.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
views.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只是因为代码是纯文本。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and public markets will enforce margin discipline.
views.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制毛利纪律。

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research, but pacing is orthogonal to security and early regulation doesn't solve risk.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建，但节奏控制与安全无关，过早监管也解决不了风险。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 需要十年才能扩散，企业的上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

views.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，因此放慢前沿节奏与安全无关。

views.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为超级智能还很遥远，递归自我改进所需的四个条件并未出现。

views.en: Most enterprises lag in AI adoption; they need context and ontology, and security must be automated with agents.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出多数企业 AI 采用严重落后，需要上下文与本体，安全则必须用智能体自动化。

views.en: Open source dominates by token count but not dollar spend; agents need infrastructure optimized for agents.
views.zh: 2026 年他观察到开源模型按 token 数占优但按花费仅 5%，智能体需要为智能体优化的基础设施。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Stop Planning for 2027: How OpenAI Ships Product in 90-Day Cycles
Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

views.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile in fast-moving AI.
views.zh: 快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证反馈；在快速变化的 AI 领域，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

views.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out; slow takeoff is happening gradually.
views.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；缓慢起飞正在逐步发生，而非突然的超级智能。

views.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; single-identity agents may not scale, bundling into chief-of-staff roles is key.
views.zh: 智能体做战术工作，人类负责掌舵；单一身份智能体可能无法扩展，打包成“幕僚长”式组合是关键。

views.en: Product-market fit is less critical than product-marketing fit; test messaging before building, and ship with conviction.
views.zh: 产品-市场匹配不如产品-营销匹配重要；先测试信息传达再构建，并带着信念交付。

views.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning, and AI's hardest part is expanding what you think is possible.
views.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；它锤炼推理，而 AI 最难的部分是拓展你对可能性的想象。

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Future and Business of AI: A Conversation with Kevin Roose and Ethan Mollick
AI Agents Could Break the Banking System — With Ethan Mollick
episodes.podEn: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味、声音与专业能力更珍贵，而初级人才梯队正在断裂。

views.en: We have moved from chatbot back-and-forth to the agentic era of long-running tasks; the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
views.zh: 已从来回对话的聊天机器人进入智能体式长任务时代；瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

views.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
views.zh: AI 参差不齐的前沿与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 降低组织成本，创造更多值得尝试的工作。

views.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; delegation risks eroding the expertise needed to judge AI output.
views.zh: 把 AI 当会挑战你的导师，而非答案机器；委托任务有侵蚀判断 AI 输出所需专业能力的风险。

views.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up to augment rather than automate; incremental productivity targets miss the point.
views.zh: 组织必须从底层重建工作流以增强而非仅自动化；渐进式生产力目标抓错了重点。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions that beat physics-based weather models in speed while matching accuracy.
views.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测，在速度上胜过基于物理的天气模型，同时精度相当。

views.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry lets one model handle both weather and climate, stabilizing long-term modeling.
views.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，让单一模型同时处理天气与气候，稳定长期建模。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data.
views.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型，跨领域训练并以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，能够超越其训练数据。

views.en: Physics models need trillion-token contexts and non-Transformer architectures, since quadratic complexity blocks high-resolution simulation.
views.zh: 物理模型需要万亿级 token 上下文与非 Transformer 架构，因为二次复杂度阻碍高分辨率模拟。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支能提升每个领域，而不只是扩大模型规模。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as agents write 100% of his code; direct human-agent interaction, not management layers, drives productivity.
views.zh: 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他 100% 的代码；提效关键在于人与智能体直接交互，而非层层人工审批。

views.en: Agents now beat most professional programmers at code; knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage, since it tempts over-prescription.
views.zh: 智能体现在写代码胜过多数职业程序员；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现细节。

views.en: Linux's old drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—become advantages in the agentic era; agents make Linux debugging far easier.
views.zh: Linux 过去的缺点——CLI、配置文件、可脚本化——在智能体时代反成优势；智能体让 Linux 调试容易得多。

views.en: The agent inflection point arrives with Opus 45; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and repetition cost nears zero, so abstractions matter less.
views.zh: 智能体的拐点随 Opus 45 到来；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性随之下降。

views.en: Handwriting code becomes an exceptional state, like a bug; every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can act without touching the UI.
views.zh: 手写代码成为例外状态，如同一个 bug；每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰界面即可操作。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

views.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, and frontier models keep growing.
views.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实；前沿模型会持续变大，小模型则趋于固定性能水平。

views.en: Human click data is a bug: agent feedback should drive ranking, with completionist crawling and authoritative excerpts replacing SEO-driven slop.
views.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷：应由智能体反馈驱动排序，用完整爬取和权威摘录取代 SEO 驱动的垃圾内容。

views.en: The internet's economics are broken for agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and ads won't work in their current form.
views.zh: 互联网经济对智能体而言已经失灵；必须通过 Shapley 值估算向内容所有者付费，而广告以现有形式无法奏效。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
views.zh: 网络正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者形成一个平行网络。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: AI policy should favor a single national framework and avoid rigid red lines, since early rules like the EU AI Act age fast.
views.zh: AI 政策应倾向单一国家框架、避免刚性红线，因为像欧盟 AI 法案这样的早期规则很快就会过时。

views.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized science.
views.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人，而非主导发现或搞集中式科学。

views.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems and preempt state patchwork rules to protect startups.
views.zh: 美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，并抢先统一各州碎片化规则以保护初创公司。

views.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission is the path to doubling US scientific output and winning against China.
views.zh: 通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 用于科学，是让美国科研产出翻倍、在与中国的竞争中胜出的路径。

views.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown and regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
views.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，监管应针对模型输出，而不是过度监管训练环节。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，瓶颈在智能问题而非制造问题。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; on-device inference and the human hand set the benchmark.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从智能具体化为数据，强调端侧推理与以人手为标杆。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他放大到 AI 整体：比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习让智能体落地。

views.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，仍处数据饥荒期。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Manufacturing 50,000 Humanoid Robots Next Year | Bernt Børnich, 1X
Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

views.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
views.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要。

views.en: First-principles design and in-house manufacturing enable fast iteration; production, not prototypes, is the hard part.
views.zh: 第一性原理设计与自建制造带来快速迭代；难的是量产而非原型。

views.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 关键是通用模型而非逐任务自动化；瓶颈是数据多样性而非数量。

views.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior.
views.zh: 模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为。

views.en: Safety and trust are prerequisites for home deployment; humans and robots will collaborate symbiotically, not replace each other.
views.zh: 安全与信任是进入家庭的前提；人与机器人将共生协作，而非彼此取代。

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: Mercor's Brendan Foody on Data, Evals & the Last Human Job
RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

views.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
views.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练智能体式数据的新前沿。

views.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; evals are the real bottleneck because RL saturates them fast.
views.zh: 模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法；评估才是真正瓶颈，因为强化学习会迅速把评估刷满。

views.en: Humans remain essential as verifiers and rubric-builders; models cannot reliably grade their own work.
views.zh: 人类仍不可或缺——负责构建验证器与评分标准，模型无法可靠地给自己的作业打分。

views.en: Creating training data becomes the last human job, as people shift to training agents and virtual co-workers.
views.zh: 创造训练数据将成为最后的人类工作，人们转向训练智能体与虚拟同事。

views.en: The next shift is ultra-long-horizon RL tasks of 100–1000 hours, while the physical world lags for superintelligence.
views.zh: 下一步是 100–1000 小时的超长时程强化学习任务；而物理世界因容错低、迭代慢，会拖慢超级智能。

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are simple next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, not complexity, with RLHF inserting values.
views.zh: 2023 年他把大模型还原为简单的下一个词预测器，认为智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计，价值观则由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; product UI must be fault-tolerant and match algorithm performance.
views.zh: 2023 年他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式产品要求容错的界面，让 UI 与算法能力相匹配。

views.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; inference's marginal cost will force business model changes.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他持续强调生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话，并进一步指出推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, not hype at big companies.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 类比智能手机级的宏观变革，认为大公司当前受 AI 影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

views.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他明确 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，并把率先拥抱技术变革视为关键，主线始终是让生成式 AI 服务于用户自主。

people.tiZh: Science 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Hodak is the CEO of Science, a company developing retinal implants to restore vision. He previously co-founded Transcriptic and was a co-founder of Neuralink.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·霍达克是 Science 公司的 CEO，该公司正在开发视网膜植入物以恢复视力。他曾共同创立 Transcriptic，并是 Neuralink 的联合创始人之一。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能打通深科技。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation, and data work.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其体现在编程、监管和数据工作上。

views.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

views.en: Retinal prostheses count as BCI; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
views.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体纳入 BCI 范畴，并认为借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

views.en: AI models and brains share representations (Platonic hypothesis), but speech is thinking and the cognitive bottleneck is ~10 bits/s.
views.zh: 2026 年他援引柏拉图表征假说认为 AI 与大脑共享内部表征，但说话即思考，认知瓶颈约每秒 10 比特。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Zipline, the world's largest commercial autonomous delivery system, which has flown over 140 million miles with zero safety incidents.
people.bioZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司是全球最大的商业自主配送系统，已安全飞行超过 1.4 亿英里。

episodes.tEn: From Rwanda to Global Logistics: Zipline's Journey

people.tiEn: Founder of Paper, AI-native design tool
people.tiZh: Paper 创始人，AI 原生设计工具
people.bioEn: Stephen Haney is the founder of Paper, an AI-native design tool that has become one of the fastest-growing design tools since Figma. He focuses on agent-first workflows and AI-driven design processes.
people.bioZh: 斯蒂芬·哈尼是 Paper 的创始人，这是一款 AI 原生设计工具，已成为自 Figma 以来增长最快的设计工具之一。他专注于智能体优先的工作流程和 AI 驱动的设计流程。

episodes.tEn: Paper: An AI-Native Design Tool for the Next Era

people.tiEn: AI Engineer, Podcaster, Operator at Cognition
people.tiZh: AI 工程师、播客主持人、Cognition 运营者
people.bioEn: Shawn Wang, also known as Swyx, is an AI engineer, podcaster, and operator at Cognition, known for his insights into AI engineering and developer communities.
people.bioZh: 王绍恩（Swyx）是 AI 工程师、播客主持人和 Cognition 的运营者，以对 AI 工程和开发者社区的见解而闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI Coding Wars and the Future of Agents

people.tiZh: Waymo 联合首席执行官
people.bioEn: Dmitri Dolgov is the co-CEO of Waymo, leading the company's autonomous driving technology development and deployment.
people.bioZh: 德米特里·多尔戈夫是 Waymo 的联合首席执行官，领导公司的自动驾驶技术研发与部署。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical AI: Lessons from Waymo's Autonomous Driving

people.tiZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Josh Meier is the co-founder of Chai Discovery, a company applying scaling laws to drug design, with a focus on AI-driven antibody engineering.
people.bioZh: 乔什·迈尔是 Chai Discovery 的联合创始人，该公司将扩展定律应用于药物设计，专注于 AI 驱动的抗体工程。

episodes.tEn: From Serendipity to Design: Engineering Biology with AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 设计师
people.bioEn: Nate Parrott is a designer at Anthropic, known for creating Claude Design, a tool that started as a side project and became a key part of Anthropic's design workflow.
people.bioZh: 内特·帕罗特是 Anthropic 的设计师，以创建 Claude Design 而闻名，该工具最初是个人副业项目，后来成为 Anthropic 设计工作流的关键部分。

episodes.tEn: Behind the Scenes of Claude Design with Nate Parrott
From Snap Engineer to Founding Designer: Nate Parrott on Designing the Arc Browser

views.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and ship rough prototypes rather than over-intellectualize.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作是浏览器设计的核心：设计师应追随好奇心、动手试错、快速迭代粗糙原型，而不是过度理性化。

views.en: Design teams need not act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
views.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不必始终步调一致，保留个人印记与多元声音反而能做出更好的作品。

views.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
views.zh: 2024 年，他坚持即便是浏览器这类工具型产品，注入情感与个性也是创造难忘体验的关键。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should spend more time walking and thinking.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：工程变容易后，设计与想法成为差异化所在，设计师应多散步、多思考，而非埋头执行。

views.en: Models lack taste, so ask for volume of options; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出模型仍缺乏品味，应靠大量选项弥补；在 AI 时代宁可过早也不要过度打磨，好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

views.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
views.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws need world models, embodiment, and open source to advance capability.
views.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；Scaling（规模扩张）需结合世界模型、具身与开源才能推进能力。

views.en: AI inverts the app model: intent-driven agents abstract brands; smart glasses enable a post-phone, personal superintelligence future.
views.zh: AI 颠覆应用模式：意图驱动的智能体抽象品牌；智能眼镜开启后手机时代的个人超级智能。

views.en: Scaling laws hold and compute drives intelligence, but frontier-open gap may not narrow; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但前沿与开源的差距未必缩小；开源是商品层，并非自持生态。

views.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; product integration and user value matter more than monolithic models or hype.
views.zh: 多数工作不需要前沿智能；产品整合与用户价值比单一模型或炒作更重要。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

views.en: The idea is secondary to the entrepreneur; building a great company requires a great founder who can execute.
views.zh: 点子在创业者面前是次要的；打造伟大公司需要能执行的伟大创始人。

views.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
views.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确而非外部认可，且会自我实现。

views.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
views.zh: 最终对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

views.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edges create network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
views.zh: 工业规模下专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计非但没死，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

views.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling through bold point of view.
views.zh: 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码：AI 降低生产门槛，但人类凭大胆观点抬高创造力天花板。

views.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and taste remain the judge of what is good, even as AI democratizes making.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：即便 AI 让创造民主化，人类判断与品味仍是评判好坏的最终标准。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, using giant prompts with context and design systems to escape cloud lock-in.
views.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具、自己写 0% 的代码，用带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词摆脱云端产品锁定。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features and iterating from references as an editor.
views.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；优势来自把最后 10% 花在独特功能上，并像编辑一样从参考出发迭代。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team—so start before ready.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事——所以要在准备好之前就开始。

views.en: Launch at 80% complete and iterate on real feedback; perfectionism is fear, and high intelligence often holds people back.
views.zh: 在完成 80% 时就发布，再依据真实反馈迭代；完美主义是恐惧，高智力反而常拖住人。

views.en: Skip venture capital: solve one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients and fund growth from revenue.
views.zh: 绕开风险投资：为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，用收入支撑增长。

From Graphic Design to Tech: Marvin Schwaibold's Journey to Shopify

views.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation are essential to stay relevant.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

views.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks judgment of what looks good.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计师定位为“编辑”：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与设定标准，因为 AI 抬高了上限却不懂什么好看。

views.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
views.zh: 他主张把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代地交给智能体，并用 DialKit 之类工具暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

views.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma; prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents.
views.zh: 他强调设计师应写代码、做测试甚至提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里设计；AI 原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力。

views.en: Less is more: progressive disclosure, clear hierarchy and native scroll; reduce features to the top three and avoid hiding content behind tabs.
views.zh: 他坚持少即是多：渐进披露、清晰层级与原生滚动；功能收敛到前三项，不要把内容藏在标签页后面。

episodes.tEn: Why Custom AI Models Will Replace Foundation Models, with Fireworks AI's Lin Qiao
Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI, will dominate; every company must own its model as token costs fall and open models spread.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专业化智能；随着 token 成本下降、开放模型普及，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat and cutting costs 5-10x.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，才能把产品市场契合变成持久护城河，并把成本降低 5-10 倍。

views.en: Inference quality is the bar; private data unlocks the next frontier, and customized models beat a few foundation models.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调推理质量是门槛：私有数据才能解锁下一个前沿，定制模型将取代少数基础模型。

views.en: Owning your model, not building on a black-box API, is the durable business; data is the real moat.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：拥有自己的模型而非依赖黑盒 API 才是持久生意，数据才是真正的护城河。

views.en: Millions of specialized models, one per use case, will replace the few-frontier-model view; application cloning is easy, data is not.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复重申反共识：未来是数百万个按用例定制的模型，而非少数前沿模型；应用易被克隆，数据不能。

views.en: AI models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and user agency.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品、拥抱破坏，并聚焦战略与用户能动性。

views.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding differentiate.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张小团队借 AI 获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当前局限构建，同时领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

views.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; launch early, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计——智能体能做用户能做的一切；应尽早发布、做减法，并随模型进步重写产品。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation to AI agents redefines productivity; verification loops and model judgment, including pushback, are essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为向 AI 智能体进行长周期任务委托将重新定义生产力；验证闭环与模型判断力（包括敢于反驳）至关重要。

views.en: Close the gap between model capabilities and actual usage; PM role remains essential, and capability blindness must be avoided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距；产品经理角色依然关键，并须避免“能力盲区”。

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while a VM sandbox keeps it safe.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否拿到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而虚拟机沙箱保证安全。

views.en: The real gap is not model capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use it for tedious background tasks and judge by final impact.
views.zh: 真正的差距不在模型能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用它处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终效果而非紧盯过程。

views.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior versus lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows.
views.zh: 相比漫长的预训练，微调快速且能有力引导模型行为；模型本身是无状态的，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的错觉。

views.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
views.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制有助于参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

views.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; tool calling adds a third entity that changes chat dynamics.
views.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益移入预训练，边界变得模糊；工具调用为对话引入第三方实体，改变了交互动态。
