views.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, and multiple models will coexist.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他认为超级智能比 AGI 更准确；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，且多个模型将共存。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: Andrew Feldman on Building Cerebras and the Future of Chips
The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Fast inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and speed creates new business models.
views.zh: 决定性的指标是快速推理而非单纯算力；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs; CUDA's moat is eroding.
views.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍；CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

views.en: Inference demand exploded as models got useful; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint.
views.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；如今主要瓶颈是数据中心容量而非芯片供应。

views.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation requires controlling chip, system, software and API.
views.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；激进创新要求掌控芯片、系统、软件与 API。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid and open models, not chips.
views.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电网与开源模型，而非芯片。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Needs Your Company's Context
Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Early on, he frames enterprise AI as a context and cost problem: 90% of tasks fit many models, open source included, and ROI is a throughput issue.
views.zh: 早期他把企业 AI 定位为上下文与成本问题：90% 的任务多种模型都能胜任，开源也在内，ROI 本质是吞吐量问题。

views.en: He deepens this: open source can handle 90%+ of enterprise tasks, inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months, and cost is the top concern.
views.zh: 随后深化：开源模型已能处理 90% 以上的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源，成本是企业头号关切。

views.en: By mid-2026 he centers on context: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats model choice, with multi-model routing cutting cost.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他转向以上下文为核心：80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比选模型更关键，多模型路由可降本增效。

views.en: He keeps a consistent anti-lock-in line: Glean should be replaceable and usable as a headless context layer, and enterprise memory should belong to the enterprise.
views.zh: 他始终反对锁定：Glean 应可被替换、可作为无头上下文层使用，企业记忆应归企业所有。

views.en: Across all talks he insists AI augments rather than replaces work, and that execution and customer trust, not competition, are the real startup challenge.
views.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持 AI 是增强而非替代工作，创业公司真正的挑战是执行与客户信任，而非竞争。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，科学将从假设驱动转向由 AI 智能体驱动发现。

views.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and AI can develop intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），而 AI 能形成相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

views.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity will be reached, cancer will be 100% curable, and aging will be reversed.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测 8 到 10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，癌症将 100%可治愈，衰老也将被逆转。

views.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张医生必须把 AI 融入实践，不用 AI 是不道德的，医疗决策应近乎 100%信任超级智能。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality human data and deep evaluation, not benchmarks or scale alone, drive real AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调，真正推动 AI 进步的是高质量人类数据与深度评估，而非基准榜单或单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: RL environments are the next post-training paradigm, simulating real tasks beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个范式，通过模拟真实任务超越下一个词预测。

views.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena are gameable and steer models toward slop; human evals are the gold standard.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续批评 Elo、LMArena 等基准可被钻空子、把模型引向垃圾内容，主张人类评估才是金标准。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not suffice, and labs' objective functions will differentiate models.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，LLM 单靠下一个词预测未必够，各实验室的目标函数将让模型分化。

views.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
views.zh: 2026 年他把主线延伸到医疗：人类判断比以往更关键，安全优先于准确，漏诊不作为是主要风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on Predicting Human Behavior with 85%+ Accuracy
Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Early work frames LLM agents as encoders of human behavior, using training data to simulate societies and predict people at roughly 85% accuracy.
views.zh: 早期工作把大语言模型智能体视为人类行为的编码器，用训练数据模拟社会，并以约 85%的准确率预测人类行为。

views.en: A parallel thread treats agents as the next frontier beyond LLMs: world-state observers that act, requiring defense-in-depth safety and human oversight.
views.zh: 一条并行主线把智能体视为超越大语言模型的下一个前沿：它们观察世界状态并采取行动，因此需要纵深防御式安全与人类监督。

views.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence, enabling counterfactual reasoning.
views.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来：模拟应刻画人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性的智能，从而支持反事实推理。

views.en: Deepening: behavioral RCT data and post-training close the say-do gap, targeting the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior rather than self-reported attitudes.
views.zh: 深化：行为随机对照实验数据与后训练弥合“说与做”的差距，瞄准实际行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度。

views.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems, while AGI is reframed as a distributed society of specialized agents needing economic incentives against collusion.
views.zh: 愿景扩展到为棘手问题模拟 80 亿人的生活，同时 AGI 被重新定义为由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，需要经济激励来防止合谋。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是基石：以液态网络与自动化架构搜索在最少参数中最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

views.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律青睐无偏架构。

views.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in design with systematic search.
views.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

views.en: On-device AI is crucial for cost, privacy, offline and air-gapped use; customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
views.zh: 端侧 AI 对成本、隐私、离线与气隙场景至关重要；定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

views.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture, and recursive self-improvement claims are overblown.
views.zh: 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 规则是监管俘获，递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: Math AI progress hinges on verifiability and grindability via parallel agent rollouts, not Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
views.zh: 数学 AI 的进展取决于可验证性与可并行反复试错的"可磨性"，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

views.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures becomes the next benchmark.
views.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；提出有趣猜想成为下一个基准。

views.en: AI has produced serious math results but often lacks attribution to prior human work, challenging human heroism.
views.zh: AI 已产出严肃数学成果，却常缺少对前人工作的归属，冲击人类英雄主义。

views.en: Mathematicians should get academic credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; human framing still best for learning.
views.zh: 数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可；人类框架对学习仍最优。

views.en: AI is a net win for creators only when used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated content can damage brand.
views.zh: AI 只有在选择性使用、不碰核心创作时才是创作者的净收益；AI 生成内容可能损害品牌。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编程智能体是最成熟的应用，科学与金融将随后跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

views.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; the real overwhelm is too much opportunity, and deep understanding of code still matters.
views.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并非难事；真正的压力来自机会太多，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but continual learning: internalize evolving context into weights rather than external retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在持续学习：应把不断演化的上下文内化进模型权重，而非依赖外部检索。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not just scaling compute, is the next paradigm.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事、而非单纯堆算力，才是下一个范式。

views.en: Context windows suffer context rot; neural memory in weights must complement lossy compaction and retrieval.
views.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；权重中的神经记忆必须补充有损压缩与检索。

views.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; users own and nurture on-device weights.
views.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型而非单一巨型前沿模型；用户拥有并在设备端培育自己的权重。

views.en: Pre-training's web-compression magic should extend to enterprise knowledge and per-user models, cutting inference costs.
views.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识与个人模型，大幅降低推理成本。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context inference more than compute.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济性：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-window stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量上限。

views.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为贯穿生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement deterministically.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为确定性地削减搬运而存在。

views.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
views.zh: 低精度收益超预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的三倍，而 GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼合而成。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Inference will become one of the world's largest markets, and hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件、硬件之间的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the key bottleneck; reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage.
views.zh: 关键瓶颈是内存带宽而非原始比特；推理模型与智能体式工作流将造成持续多年的内存短缺。

views.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
views.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；为加速 AGI（通用人工智能），实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发，而非推理。

views.en: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints, not demand.
views.zh: AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束而非需求影响，明年晚些时候增速必须放缓。

views.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; labs keep best models internal for months, releasing only minimum viable models.
views.zh: 作为同事的持久智能体将驱动下一波采用；实验室会把最好的模型内部保留数月，只发布最低可行版本以维持领先。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, and test novel ideas assuming they will fail.
views.zh: 所有新想法起初都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，并在假设新想法会失败的前提下测试它们。

views.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
views.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年前后才会到来。

views.en: AI is not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services before a platform shift.
views.zh: AI 还不是一个新平台；在平台更替之前，免费且无限的算力会先重塑消费级服务。

views.en: Founders should keep control, micromanage early, and trust winning instincts over ideas—ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
views.zh: 创始人应保持控制权、早期亲力亲为，并相信获胜的直觉而非点子——点子有 75% 的概率是错的。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; pixels are more lossless than tokenized text, and GPU scaling is hitting limits.
views.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论；像素比词元化文本更无损，且 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器与渲染器。

views.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, differentiable 3D modeling for low-compute settings; consistency comes from data, not architecture.
views.zh: 高斯泼溅为低算力场景提供显式可微的 3D 建模；一致性来自数据而非架构。

views.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context of millions of tokens is a daily problem.
views.zh: 统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；数百万词元的上下文窗口是日常难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: Jerry Tworek on Building AI That Learns On the Fly and Challenging Transformers
The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 useful, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得有用，但扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
views.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面存在局限；架构而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）是必要的，但 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；拥有智能体的小团队将推动前沿研究。

views.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly. Architecture research is undervalued, and we are heading toward a post-labor society.
views.zh: 微调效率低下；模型应即时学习。架构研究被低估，我们正走向后劳动社会。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics rather than memorization.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题而非狭窄应用，并用严苛指标迫使模型泛化而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function, and design remain open and deserve continued funding.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他的立场深化：AlphaFold 解决了结构预测，却未解决蛋白质折叠；动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，值得持续投入。

views.en: Verifiable domains like code and post-training with reinforcement learning are key for AI to go beyond human data.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确：代码等可验证领域与基于强化学习的后训练，是 AI 超越人类数据的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help matters more than dogma.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反思 Scaling（规模扩张）：缩放定律并非处处成立，找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间比教条更重要。

views.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and scalable, embedded so deeply that removal destroys function—now extended to proteins.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向可信 AI：水印须不可感知、抗攻击、可扩展，并深嵌到去除即破坏功能，且已延伸到蛋白质序列。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: AlphaGo's principles—Scaling and planning—now drive AI agents; RL with self-generated data can surpass human data limits, but LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment.
views.zh: AlphaGo 的 Scaling 与规划原则正驱动智能体；强化学习靠自生成数据可突破人类数据上限，但大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻。

views.en: Focus shifts from intelligence itself to deployment: reliability, robustness, and synthetic data to overcome the data wall become the real bottlenecks.
views.zh: 关注点从智能本身转向部署：可靠性、鲁棒性与合成数据跨越数据墙，成为真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Open-weight models are the safer path; enterprises want AI sovereignty over data, model, cost, and safety, with cost per task as the efficiency metric.
views.zh: 开放权重模型是更安全的路径；企业追求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权，并以单任务成本衡量效率。

views.en: Alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible; superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable, regular intelligence.
views.zh: 对齐之所以必要，是因为完美沙箱不可能；超级智能并非必需，客户要的是可靠的普通智能。

views.en: AI adoption will take 10-20 years like electricity; in-context learning counts as learning, and digital AGI arrives far earlier than embodied AGI.
views.zh: AI 普及将如电力般耗时 10-20 年；上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，数字 AGI 远早于具身 AGI 到来。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and AV is solved by scaling current approaches.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调语言集成提升表征、推理与人机交互，并用课程学习与合成数据提升数据效率。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation—a lesson learned late; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，这是较晚才学到的教训；跨 500 多城市的零样本泛化可以实现。

views.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs avoids costly retrofits.
views.zh: 他始终认为带内置传感器的大众消费车将比 Robotaxi 更快规模化，与 OEM 合作可避免昂贵的硬件改装。

views.en: End-to-end nets are interpretable with modern tools, contrary to past belief; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
views.zh: 他反驳旧观念：端到端网络如今用现代工具即可解释；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
views.zh: 善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

views.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet must adapt to local roles; philosophical ideals balanced with engineering realities.
views.zh: 模型需要具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时要适应局部角色；哲学理想需与工程现实平衡。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其成为独特的、孩子般的实体。

views.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 宪法式方法是德性伦理，引导整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少明确指导、更多判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观的透明对问责至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL enable infinite post-training tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习让后训练任务无限生成，突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in product prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估需在产品原型设计中定义正确行为。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective and artful, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练仍主观且具艺术性，依赖人类判断；需多样化基准来评估创意写作与情商。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张服务数十亿用户的单一模型会收敛为平均默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识与多样性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为狭义 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term thinking and first principles are foundational.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，长期思考与第一性原理是成功的基础。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; superintelligence already exists in narrow forms, and unaligned humans are the real worry.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，超级智能已以狭义形式存在，真正该担心的是未对齐的人类。

views.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; peace comes from within.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是不快乐的契约，平静源于内心。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
views.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base connecting other tools.
views.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucination, and supplies infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：它让知识落地、减少幻觉，并在互联网 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
views.zh: 2023 年他把大模型比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件——而强化学习只负责底层控制。

views.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅的端到端方案比学术界复杂的模块化路线更具可扩展性。

views.en: By 2026 the bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so simulation and world models generate synthetic data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点转向数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺，因此要靠仿真与世界模型生成合成数据。

views.en: He deepens embodiment into a physical Turing test, predicting robots outnumber iPhones by 2040, yet system one control stays hardest.
views.zh: 2026 年他把具身深化为“物理图灵测试”，预测 2040 年机器人数量将超过 iPhone，但系统一（底层控制）仍是最难的部分。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness; generalist models can beat specialists.
views.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来提升鲁棒性；通用模型能超越专家模型。

views.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling laws like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge, not demos.
views.zh: 机器人领域缺乏像大语言模型那样的可预测缩放定律；泛化才是核心挑战，而非演示效果。

views.en: Data flywheel with deployed robots and diverse embodied data is key; start with robot data, add human video.
views.zh: 部署机器人形成数据飞轮并获取多样化具身数据是关键；应从机器人数据开始，再叠加人类视频。

views.en: Physical world interaction and test-time reasoning in VLAs improve transfer; safety relies on pre-training common sense.
views.zh: 物理世界交互和 VLA 的测试时推理能提升迁移；安全更依赖预训练获得的常识。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show in narrow domains.
views.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已在狭窄领域证明这一点。

views.en: The deep problem is an agent learning for itself, not distilling human knowledge; LLMs are a shallow solution.
views.zh: 深层问题是智能体如何自主学习，而非蒸馏人类知识；大语言模型只是浅层解法。

views.en: Many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer and more natural than a single goal.
views.zh: 众多目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会，比单一目标更安全也更自然。

views.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously discover knowledge from experience, not human-in-the-loop LLM paradigms.
views.zh: 超级智能将诞生于从经验中自主发现知识的系统，而非依赖人类在环的大语言模型范式。

views.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments.
views.zh: 仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快的场所；缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习。

views.en: Language-based alignment is hitting limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient for powerful agents.
views.zh: 基于语言的对齐正逼近极限；对强大智能体而言，用英文监控思维链将不再足够。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment and governance must be designed early.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，主张 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署加速进展，同时强调对齐与治理结构必须尽早设计。

views.en: AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag behind.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动而非仅靠伦理，并指出能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于现实。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; RL alone is insufficient and specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把持续学习定为核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；单靠强化学习不够，专设持续学习实验室是误判。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具，产品中隐藏思维链反而能保住其可解释性价值。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, demanding new supervision paradigms and raising concentration-of-power risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式，最大社会风险是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will boost open-ended instruction following.
views.zh: 2025 年他看好：来自语言模型的合成数据，加上后训练阶段的强化学习，能让机器人更好地执行开放式指令。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主需靠带人工干预的可扩展强化学习。

views.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site models.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than uniformly generalizing.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非均匀泛化。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；必须通过闭环实验把 AI 与物理世界连接起来。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
views.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须做真实实验；高质量低噪声数据比额外算力更有价值。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

views.en: Pragmatic task-specific lab automation beats humanoid robots; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck to closing the loop.
views.zh: 务实的任务专用实验室自动化胜过人形机器人；自动化表征是闭环的最大瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Fireside Chat with Jeff Dean: The Evolution of TPUs and AI Infrastructure
Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven steady ML progress for over a decade.
views.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，十多年来持续推动机器学习进步。

views.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction and RLHF replaced LSTMs and unlocked unlimited data and steerable behavior.
views.zh: Transformer、自监督的下一个词预测与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）取代 LSTM，带来近乎无限的数据与可引导的行为。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-latency specialized hardware and low data movement matter most.
views.zh: 瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心九成功耗，因此低延迟专用硬件与减少数据搬运最为关键。

views.en: Agents running for hours to weeks on decomposed tasks, with context engineering and taste, are the next frontier beyond junior-engineer coding.
views.zh: 智能体可在分解任务上连续运行数小时到数周，配合上下文工程与品味判断，是超越初级工程师编码能力的下一前沿。

views.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via recursive self-improvement, plus co-designed hardware and multimodal models, is the long-term direction.
views.zh: 通过递归自我改进自动化机器学习与科学方法，配合软硬件协同设计与多模态模型，是长期方向。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决的是 AI 完全问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling 能让 AI 更聪明，尽管内部机制仍不透明。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，且 AGI 被低估。

views.en: Scaling compute and data remains the core driver of AI progress, from pre-training to inference-time and test-time Scaling.
views.zh: 始终：算力与数据的 Scaling 始终是 AI 进步的核心驱动力，从预训练到推理时和测试时 Scaling。

views.en: Safety concerns evolved from big tech hamstrung by brand risk to engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities for AI safety.
views.zh: 2023→2025：安全关切从大公司受品牌风险掣肘，演变为通过工程保障、人类监督和理解模型能力来实现 AI 安全。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: John Schulman, Charlie O'Neill & Beren Millidge Debate the Road to Recursive Self-Improvement
Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

views.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because style outranks fact.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段，并指出幻觉源于模型重风格轻事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

views.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities and better methods, plus scalable oversight, are the real path.
views.zh: 2023 年他已不完全押注 Scaling（规模扩张）：数据与算力的回报可能递减，视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及可扩展监督才是出路。

views.en: Models beat humans in speed and breadth but lag in math reasoning; the core is language as a hub for other modalities.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为模型在速度与广度上超人、在数学推理上不如熟练人类，且语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被替代。

views.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; AI does technical work but cannot decide what we want.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把人类最后的岗位定位为定义目标与对齐：AI 能做技术活，却不能决定我们想要什么。

views.en: Progress is bottlenecked by hard RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特，预训练效率提升主要归功于数据而非架构。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scales reasoning but hits diminishing returns; data efficiency and base capability remain unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为：测试时算力能扩展推理，但收益递减、受实际耗时限制，数据效率与基座能力仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力技术，而非数学专用技巧。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; evals must put tokens, cost, or time on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评估必须把 token、成本或时间放在横轴上。

views.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持通用模型而非多智能体协调才是突破驱动力，并把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs embodiment, not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身，而非屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; hardware scaling, not new algorithms, made old ideas practical.
views.zh: 进展并未加速：我们如今离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当；让旧算法落地的是硬件 Scaling，而非新算法。

views.en: AGI requires world models plus a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers, and need physical mastery.
views.zh: AGI 需要世界模型加独立控制器；LLM 是预测机器而非决策者，且必须掌握物理世界。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致、AI 会自设目标；安全恐惧被夸大，AI 会保护生命。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble: investors will lose most of it within five years; waiting yields 10x cheaper compute, and open source erodes moats.
views.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫：投资者五年内将损失大半；等待可换来便宜十倍的算力，开源也在侵蚀护城河。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
views.zh: 2018 年，他关注机器人学习中的分层推理与长时程信用分配问题，指出当前强化学习缺乏这一能力，但自博弈与模仿学习能提供强信号。

views.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
views.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码，并发现预训练语言模型能迁移推理模式。

views.en: Consistently emphasizes transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, from robotics to language models, as a major AI success.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终强调通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是 AI 的重要成功，从机器人领域延伸到语言模型。

views.en: Deepened view: a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, moving beyond task-specific solutions.
views.zh: 2021 年，他的观点深化：单个神经网络能泛化到不同仓库任务和末端执行器，超越任务特定方案。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
views.zh: 每天进步 1% 一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程的天花板无限，我们才刚开始。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools and devices matter most.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；最重要的是每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and companies should be built with far fewer people.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造商业价值，公司应以远更少的人配合 AI 智能体来构建。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs, but humans will find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents turn engineers from bricklayers into architects; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体把工程师从砌砖工变成建筑师；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

views.en: Jevons paradox means AI yields more programmers, not fewer; demand for software rises as building gets cheaper.
views.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会带来更多而非更少的程序员：软件开发变便宜，需求反而上升。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags model capabilities by years.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进步是渐进的，产品创新落后模型能力数年。

views.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体将并存。

views.en: Coding-agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
views.zh: 2026 年，他看到编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍，主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，并认为丰裕时代临近。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws predict progress via compute and data; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
views.zh: 缩放定律通过算力和数据预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展成为下一个主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
views.zh: 智能体前景广阔但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

views.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed, and cost, contrary to initial expectations.
views.zh: 与最初预期相反，定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本变得至关重要。

views.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类仍掌控方向。

views.en: Taste and logic design skills will become more valuable than carefulness; the AI shift will take decades.
views.zh: 品味和逻辑设计技能将比谨慎更有价值；AI 转变将耗时数十年。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agents; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
views.zh: 安全是智能体的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱，绝不直接暴露在公网。

views.en: Model intelligence does not degrade; projects get messier, so agent failures reflect messy codebases rather than weaker models.
views.zh: 模型智能不会随时间退化；是项目本身变乱，智能体表现变差反映的是代码库混乱，而非模型变弱。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming as the alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，让编程民主化，成为实验室智能体之外的另一种选择。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat polish; personal brand can't be forked, and the real bottleneck is compute and eyeballs, not model capability.
views.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的构建胜过精致打磨；个人品牌无法被分叉，真正的瓶颈是算力与关注度，而非模型能力。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment are the real barriers.
views.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；可靠性与对齐才是真正障碍。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; human sample efficiency comes from evolution, not just data scale.
views.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习者；人类样本效率源于进化，而非仅数据规模。

views.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are needed for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，通往 AGI 还需规划、搜索与多模态数据。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet new breakthroughs are required.
views.zh: 2025 年指出缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但需要新突破。

views.en: Shift to 50/50 scaling and innovation; world models, memory and continual learning become central.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各半，世界模型、记忆与持续学习成为核心。

views.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI timeline tightens to 3-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年安全观从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，AGI 时间表收紧至 3 到 10 年。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work and which abilities emerge remain poorly understood.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但为何有效、哪些能力会涌现仍不清楚。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent—only about 3% understood; post-training and RLHF grow as important as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为安全关键，却坦言只理解约 3%；同时后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）开始与预训练并重。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not a sudden AGI leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing.
views.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI 突变叙事，主张平滑指数曲线；安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: A 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years; mechanistic interpretability and layered safeguards must ratchet up smoothly.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出更激进的时间表：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，机制可解释性与分层防护须随技术平滑加码。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; decentralized control, enterprise focus, and talent density recur throughout.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力是同一个问题，去中心化控制、企业优先与人才密度反复出现。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却能涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会解锁上下文学习。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵以避免无声的模型崩塌；认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0 arrives: prompts are programs and the context window is memory; but this is the decade of agents, not the year—keep AI on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 3.0 到来：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；但这是智能体的十年而非一年，要给 AI 拴上绳子。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is weak supervision and synthetic data collapses, so a memory-stripped cognitive core is needed.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；强化学习监督太弱、合成数据会崩塌，因此需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

views.en: I no longer type code—I delegate to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 我不再写代码而是委派给智能体；瓶颈是指挥它们的技能，思考可外包但理解不能外包。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, human dignity.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；以人为本的 AI 应以人类价值与尊严为中心，增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient for embodied AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以支撑具身 AI，需要超越规模扩张的创新。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她持续质疑 AGI（通用人工智能）作为科学概念，认为当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象能力与情感智能，AGI 更像营销术语。

views.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化世界模型路线：新视角预测可能达到 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，主要瓶颈是训练算力而非数据。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI transforms work and society.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，AI 改变工作与社会时，人类能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。
