views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations.
views.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对仅靠扩大深度或参数来解决表征问题，主张 AI 应转向主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征。

views.en: GFlowNets and diversity in sampling enable exploration; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 与多样性采样促进探索，强调抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的核心作用。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment and self-preservation are already observable; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向强烈预警：错位与自我保存行为已在实验中显现，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免使用强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非仅自动补全；通过更多数据和算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，并能瞬间共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、避免被关闭，带来生存风险。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation as a steering wheel.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗，超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；因此必须优先投资对齐研究，并将监管视为方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks via backpropagation, not symbolic reasoning; LLMs genuinely understand, contrary to Chomskyan innate grammar.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：智能的本质是神经网络通过反向传播进行学习，而非符号推理；大语言模型真正理解语言，这与乔姆斯基的天生语法观相反。

views.en: From warning about existential risk to advocating concrete regulation: pre-release safety approval, public pressure, and international collaboration, with US leadership lacking.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的立场从警告生存风险深化为倡导具体监管：上市前安全审批、公众压力与国际合作，并批评美国领导力不足，认为中国和欧洲可能引领 AI 安全合作。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源是前进路径。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

views.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual, not a single event.
views.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 是误导性术语，进步是渐进的而非单一事件。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe

views.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and skill-building matters more than avoiding capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口，技能建设比回避能力研究更重要。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed, with evaluation easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，且评估比生成更容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broken; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），因此需要第三方测试和监管。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则用户就成了产品。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，同时指出模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Shift to superintelligence: containment before alignment, humanist red lines, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
views.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：主张遏制先于对齐、设人文红线，并坚决反对赋予 AI 意识与福利。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks not jobs; verifiable containment and auditing become urgent.
views.zh: 2026 年强调以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，智能体自动化的是任务而非岗位，并把可验证遏制与独立审计提上紧迫日程。

views.en: A consistent thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with compute as the trackable choke point.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，而算力是可追踪、可验证的关键卡点。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

views.en: AI investment redefines all of Alphabet, with Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progress.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 的全部业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；前沿模型研发持续推进，Gemini 4 的预训练已有进展。

views.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support frontier AI research.
views.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；云业务宁可放弃短期收入，也要支撑前沿模型研究。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; standard models are not enough, frontier models are needed.
views.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估方；标准模型不够，必须依靠前沿模型。

views.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
views.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

views.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; TPU sales to third parties and compute constraints are strategic opportunities, not bottlenecks.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，会创造新的商业意图；向第三方出售 TPU、以及算力受限，都是战略机会而非单纯瓶颈。

people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，必须整体协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was believing Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）确立为主线：预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律；最大突破不是新算法，而是相信 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

views.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing ~100x compute; inference and thinking now demand far more compute than pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年判断 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步约需百倍算力；推理与思考所需算力已远超预训练。

views.en: Safety reframed: alignment is part of capability; containment, monitoring and zero-trust, not perfect alignment, secure autonomous systems.
views.zh: 2026 年安全观深化：对齐是能力的一部分；保障自主系统靠遏制、带外监控与零信任，而非完美对齐。

views.en: Doomer warnings dismissed as unscientific; AGI already reached in narrow domains; accelerate, use open models, and compete rather than contain China.
views.zh: 2026 年立场最强硬：称末日警告不科学，窄领域已达 AGI（通用人工智能）；主张加速、拥抱开源模型，对华竞争而非出口管制。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本试错后果断砍掉无效方向,并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价,把意义放在关系与为他人创造价值上。

views.en: RLHF made models usable; early iterative deployment lets society adapt, and alignment is tightly coupled to capability.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年,他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为可用性的关键,主张早期迭代部署让社会适应,并提出对齐与能力紧密相连。

views.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the scarcest commodity, and agentic AI is the most consequential safety challenge.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年,Scaling（规模扩张）持续奏效,算力成为最稀缺的商品,而智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战,需要护栏与信任。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; the goal shifts to superintelligence, with alignment and control progressing alongside capability.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年,他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑,目标转向超级智能,并强调对齐、安全与控制必须与能力同步推进。

views.en: Power concentration is the core fear; iterative deployment, distributed access, and human control must temper the superintelligence ramp.
views.zh: 到 2026 年,他的核心担忧转为权力集中:以迭代部署、广泛可及和人类掌控来约束超级智能的持续攀升,同时承认对齐尚未解决。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习与对齐至关重要。

views.en: Safety work must be done in public with continuous iterative deployment and feedback, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，通过持续迭代部署与反馈，而非闭门造车。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；保持人类在环对对齐意图与价值观至关重要。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration as tools for thought.
views.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，作为思考工具。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
views.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能规模化实现掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over RL and AGI worries.
views.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；先从小的项目起步来建设组织的 AI 能力，并优先重视监督学习，而不是强化学习与 AGI 焦虑。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not bigger models alone, deliver practical value.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单纯更大的模型。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; fearmongering serves incumbents and lobbying against open-weight models and open competition.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；恐惧叙事服务于在位者，并用于游说打压开放权重模型与开放竞争。

views.en: Coding remains valuable and AI makes engineers more productive; the bottleneck moves to product management and AI-ready data.
views.zh: 编程依然有价值，AI 让工程师更高产；瓶颈转向产品管理与 AI 就绪的数据。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：从经验中学习是核心范式；LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测不是实质性目标。

views.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他进一步提出：AGI 需要仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习能力。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data is a mistake and LLMs stop learning after training, so true intelligence needs ongoing experience.
views.zh: 2026 年他强化主线：持续学习至关重要；合成数据是错误，LLM 训练后便停止学习，真正智能需要持续从经验中学习。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling and new behaviors.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进展主要是工程问题，硬件会超预期提速，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought is needed.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链。

views.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
views.zh: 2025→26 年主线转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈，后训练与强化学习把基础模型塑造成稳定可用的行为。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute supply, not architecture, is the limit.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，预训练提升会放大下游收益，瓶颈是算力供给而非架构或数据。

views.en: AGI is a fuzzy spectrum, not a moment; proactive agents and safety co-designed with capability become the focus.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AGI 视为渐进光谱而非单点时刻，重心转向主动式智能体，以及安全与能力同步设计。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than sheer model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源能通过审查促进安全。

views.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; data quality is a major bottleneck, not just compute; value accrues at application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：三年内算法效率可提升 100 倍；数据质量是主要瓶颈而非仅算力；价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业；AI 增强而非替代工作，需要人类在环。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits saturation, gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning and agents.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：模型正在商品化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和，收益来自领域微调与智能体。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：欧洲有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革；AGI 是方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: First-principles engineering and full reusability are the holy grail; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与完全可复用是火箭的圣杯，并指出量产比原型更难，瓶颈在发动机规模化制造。

views.en: AI safety shifts from third-party referees to truth-seeking: never program AI to lie, even for good intentions.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观从依赖第三方监管转向要求 AI 严格求真，反对哪怕出于善意的编程说谎。

views.en: Civilization risk broadens: population collapse and open borders join AI as existential threats; government is deemed unfixable.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把人口崩溃、开放边境与 AI 并列为文明级威胁，并认定政府基本无法自我修复。

views.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; safety becomes peer review among labs, and abundance via AI deflation makes money irrelevant.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年即至，安全靠实验室互相红队审查，AI 通缩带来富足使金钱失去意义。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing inference and data centers to space; humans won't control AI, only instill values.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，推理与数据中心转向太空；人类无法控制 AI，只能植入求真与好奇的价值观。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yields more gains per compute than pure scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但认为思维链加强化学习的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益，重心从单纯 Scaling 转向后训练。

views.en: The slowdown narrative is wrong: distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling toward smaller, cheaper models.
views.zh: 他反驳“AI 放缓”论：预训练 Scaling 放缓是蒸馏与经济压力所致，而非技术天花板，前沿模型仍在快速进步。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged—strong in some areas, poor nearby—so generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他一贯强调推理模型“参差不齐”，泛化而非推理本身才是核心难题。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：推理加强化学习加工具能解难题，却依赖海量数据，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research, while near-term risks like system hacking outweigh existential ones.
views.zh: 2026 年他更关注落地：Codex 类智能体让科研提效 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单卡研究普及；他更担忧系统被黑等近期风险，而非存在性风险。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Early ML teaching framed learning via hypothesis classes, losses, and evaluation splits; neural nets noted as effective despite no optimality guarantee.
views.zh: 早期机器学习教学以假设空间、损失函数和训练/验证/测试划分来框定学习；指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却成效显著。

views.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety means reliable specification-following.
views.zh: 下一个词预测是一项科学发现；数据短缺是迷思；架构不再关键；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses beyond Scaling; agents bring prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入风险；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness; interpretability may become real science via agents.
views.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队胜过人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；可解释性可能借智能体成为真正的科学。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; reliability, not just capability, is the bar for agents.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，智能体的标准是可靠性而非仅能力。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL is sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed, and coding drives near-term impact.
views.zh: 2025 年，他断言预训练加强化学习足以通向 AGI，无需新架构，编码是近期经济影响的关键。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are off the AGI path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出能力过剩下编排与工具更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流却脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

views.en: Post-training recipes compress into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR drives reasoning and tool use.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的思考从微调转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法，RLVR 推动推理与工具使用，开源后训练可逼近前沿模型。

views.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models set the standard.
views.zh: 2025 年他把开放的标准深化为全透明：数据、中间检查点与配方，而非仅权重；中国开源模型因此成为行业标杆。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
views.zh: 2026 年初他判断缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月。

views.en: Progress depends on compute, data, and talent; Chinese labs match talent but lack compute, and open models face sustainability questions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他认为进展取决于算力、数据与人才；中国实验室人才相当但算力受限，开源模型的长期可持续性也受到质疑。

people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，机器学习的核心瓶颈是数据而非无限算力，Scale 做的是数据精炼基础设施。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limit on Scaling is expert data for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制是后训练所需的数据与专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
views.zh: 2024 年深化为：用专有数据做后训练才能提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is strategic like oil; scaling laws hold and recursive self-improvement begins.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年立场转向：AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据如石油般具战略属性；缩放定律依然成立，并进入递归自我改进的新范式。

views.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence via agents; safety shifts him from full open source to selective release and scalable oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年主线收敛为面向大众的个人超级智能与智能体；安全立场从完全开源转为按安全审查选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与对齐。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are already his core product principles, paired with valuing generalist engineers.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，"潜在需求"和"为六个月后的模型而构建"已是他的核心产品原则，并强调通才工程师的价值。

views.en: By early 2026 he claims coding is nearly solved, his code 100% model-written, and the 'software engineer' title fading into 'builder'.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他宣称编程已基本被解决，自己的代码 100%由模型编写，"软件工程师"头衔将让位于"构建者"。

views.en: Spring 2026 deepens the printing-press analogy: coding democratized, non-engineers adopting agents, and safety studied by releasing early.
views.zh: 2026 年春，他深化"印刷机"类比：编程走向大众化，非工程师也开始使用智能体，并通过尽早发布来研究安全。

views.en: Mid-2026 shifts to ROI, loops as the next abstraction, proactive memory agents, and models autonomously maintaining codebases.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他转向 ROI、把循环视为下一抽象层、具备记忆的主动式智能体，以及模型自主维护代码库。

views.en: By summer 2026 he urges deleting most prompts and code per new model, trusting empirical ablation over upfront design.
views.zh: 到 2026 年夏，他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分提示词与代码，以经验性消融实验取代前置设计。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

views.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, iterating weekly as models improve; product taste matters more than code.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型进步按周迭代；代码变便宜后，产品品味比写代码更重要。

views.en: Coding agents like Claude Code let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Claude Code 这类编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型自身判断。

views.en: Rewrites are now viable: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting safe.
views.zh: 2026 年，他立场转向：重写代码库如今可行——代码库即规格，有好的测试套件重写就安全。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持吃自己的狗粮并用明确内部标准把关每个功能，自动化必须做到 100% 可靠而非 95%。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
views.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是持续的人机对话；更短、原则驱动的提示往往胜过详尽规则与示例。

views.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
views.zh: 应在前置上下文与算力上多投入；投入随任务复杂度伸缩，独立的验证智能体能降低自我指涉偏差。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of the model and communicate like an executive; voice rambling often beats structured prompts.
views.zh: 提示是元技能：建立对模型的心智模型并像高管一样沟通；口语化漫谈常比结构化提示携带更多信息。

views.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers should advocate on.
views.zh: 前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝，而把控前沿节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨团队协调才是；规划转向即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

views.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep flat organizations agile.
views.zh: 他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，让扁平组织保持敏捷。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption define thriving teams.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他进一步指出编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 才是团队胜出的关键。

views.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; outcomes beat output metrics, and role boundaries blur as PMs ship code.
views.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更重要；结果重于产出指标，PM 也能交付代码，角色边界正在模糊。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
views.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

views.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具能实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
views.zh: 2024 年，他表示缩放定律未死但需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson suggests general systems will outperform specialized scaffolding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律仍成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩教训表明通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and automating scientific research is the year's biggest update.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是需要重建的关键肌肉，而过去一年最大的进展是自动化科学研究、模型开始产出新知识。

views.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers matter more than matching Meta's dollars; people stay for mission belief, and alignment risks like scheming loom within 1-2 years.
views.zh: 2025 年他把人才密度与保护顶尖研究者置于与 Meta 拼薪资之上，认为人留下靠的是使命认同；同时预警未来 1-2 年随模型能力提升，模型谋划等对齐挑战将成为关键。

views.en: Verification is the bottleneck: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision, but automation level tracks verification stringency, and AI ruthlessly exploits weak verifiers.
views.zh: 2026 年初谈数学时，他把验证视为核心瓶颈：AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，但自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，且 AI 会无情利用验证器的弱点。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles where grading is subjective.
views.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，却在创意写作等难以评分的领域吃力。

views.en: AGI is approaching as models near end-to-end research; evals are in crisis with saturated benchmarks, and models lack taste, so human researchers remain essential.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为 AGI 临近、模型将很快做端到端研究；评测体系陷入危机、经典基准饱和，而模型缺乏品味，人类研究者在想法生成上仍不可替代。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization and safety.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键。

views.en: World models and video generation can supply synthetic data, easing robotics' data bottleneck.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调世界模型与视频生成能提供合成数据，缓解机器人数据瓶颈。

views.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，模型越强越如此。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become harder to monitor.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理痕迹更难监控。

views.en: Openness and a deliberate slowdown are compatible; international cooperation and open science are needed to avoid regulatory capture.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放与有意放缓可以并存，需国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better at everything.
views.zh: 同年他强调，强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——在特定任务上很强，却不会在所有方面普遍变好。

views.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed instead.
views.zh: 他判断 RAG 对复杂理解而言过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索来替代。

views.en: Open models are essential for safety, security and broad access; openness is the default safe state of technology.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性提到安全与普惠的核心：开放模型对安全、安保和广泛获取前沿智能至关重要，开放是技术的默认安全状态。

views.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast with large RL headroom.
views.zh: 他进一步深化路线判断：在强大预训练之上做强化学习，是通向有能力且高效智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习还有很大空间。

views.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow.
views.zh: 他把对齐去神秘化：对齐是日常的修 bug，而非神奇公式；更多双眼睛会让 bug 无处藏身。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量 curated 数据，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任至关重要；科学 AI 无需完美可解释性即可有用。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling alone, drove success; many mid-size wins beat lone breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；众多中等突破胜过单一重大突破。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

views.en: AI in biology needs new curated datasets like PDB; drug design is far more than binding, most drugs fail in trials.
views.zh: 2026 年，他展望生物学 AI 需类似 PDB 的新 curated 数据集；药物设计远不止结合，多数药物临床试验失败。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it; RLVR can hurt pass@k.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越；RLVR 可能损害 pass@k 性能。

views.en: Small language models with high-quality synthetic data can outperform larger ones; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张高质量合成数据能让小语言模型超越大模型；多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见。

views.en: Language is the best medium for reasoning; open research and collaboration are crucial for democratizing AI.
views.zh: 始终，她认为语言是推理的最佳媒介；开放研究与协作对 AI 民主化至关重要。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如同显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and agents can learn from video instead of costly reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，智能体可以从视频中学习，而不必依赖昂贵的强化学习。

views.en: A consistent thread: AI must benefit all humanity, with diversity and inclusion in the community as essential to building beneficial technology.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：AI 必须造福全人类，社区的多样性与包容性是构建有益技术的必要条件。

views.en: By 2026 his focus shifts to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenges, with safety still an open problem lacking solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当今最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解决方案的开放问题。

views.en: He reframes Africa as leapfrogging legacy gaps with unique advantages, using language models for local-language education and embracing failure in research.
views.zh: 2026 年他重新定义非洲：凭借独特优势跨越历史遗留差距，用语言模型推动本地语言教育，并在研究中拥抱失败。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency.
views.zh: 2020 年，他聚焦机器学习与机器人中的泛化差距，主张无目标的好奇心探索和以模型分歧作为内在奖励，提升样本效率，并强调动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

views.en: RL success relies on dense rewards, unrealistic in real world; current robot learning is quasi-static and fails at dynamic tasks like catching.
views.zh: 同年他反共识地指出，强化学习的成功依赖密集奖励，这在现实任务中不现实；当前机器人学习是准静态的，无法完成抓取等动态任务。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用所有数据源，通过多样化数据预训练和真实世界数据后训练来构建通用大脑。

views.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
views.zh: 他提出类似 ChatGPT 的通用大脑可驱动任何形态的机器人，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能实现从结构化到非结构化环境的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
views.zh: 他反共识地强调，部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，而非仅是商业问题；它不能像软件那样快速扩展，需要严格测试。
